title: Real revenue, no system
summary: The round-9 interior head in GoNimbly's composition: a 104px h1 (“Real revenue, / but no system / under it.”) with the accent in the middle of the sentence, phone floor 48 (42 below 360), the lede and one quiet action at the right, the film stand-in under it.

reference.site: GoNimbly (the founder's screenshots and recordings, refs-r9/) · kit §12.3 side head, §12.4 film plate
reference.borrowed: Headline at the left, a short line behind a vertical rule at the right, and moving footage directly under the head, edge to edge of the measure.
reference.kelwin: Kelwin's type and grid: the 48×2 red rule tops the right column, the accent is the light weight (never italic), the plate is the hero's frosted stand-in cropped to the left half of the picture (kit-enforced) with no take, timecode or REC, tagged "Stand-in".

motion: entrance (stitched page, kit §13): the turn lifts, the h1 writes itself in with a hard pen edge, line after line (the accent keeps its weight), then the hairline draws down with the rule, the lede and the action rise, then the plate rises narrower and widens to the measure. Filmed in qa/r9-pages/wwww/look/arrive-sheet.png.
ambient: the plate's frosted footage drifts slowly (base .km-film).
interaction: the one quiet action jumps to #send-away (scroll margin clears production's fixed bar).
on the live site: the same arrival on every visit. Reduced motion: no turn, no write-in, no rise; the final head at once.
story: Answers the visitor's question ('is a company like mine what Kelwin is for, or will they turn me away?') in two lines: the h1 is the first condition (real revenue, but no system under it), the lede the other two (a committee decides the deal, someone inside will own the build). The one action goes straight to the honest other half: who we send away.
copy: [N] h1 'Real revenue, / but no system under it.' (accent 'no system'; replaces [K] 'Three situations, told from inside.', which now only labels the situations section the homepage link lands on)
[N] lede 'For companies whose deals a committee decides, with someone inside who will own what we build.' (from the fit criteria F-01–F-03; no noun phrase of the h1 reused)
Cut: the 'Who we work with' kicker (the page's own name), 'The Firm / 02', the facts box (Built for / The real gate / Not sure?), the break chart with its glyphs, flags, codes, key and keyed list.
shoot_brief: Real footage to replace the stand-in: a buyer-side working session, the moment a deal is explained by someone other than the founder — two or three people at a table, shot over a shoulder, faces out of focus, a whiteboard or a printed page between them; frosted and graded like the hero. 12–16 s loop, 2.52 : 1 at 1440 (the plate is 1312 × 520), muted. Never staged stock people, never AI-generated.
phone: ≤1023 the side head stacks (kit): h1 full width (3 lines at 834: 'Real revenue, / but no system / under it.'), rule, lede, the action under it; film plate 50% of the stage tall. ≤767: h1 at the kit's 56px floor, 4 lines at 390 ('Real revenue, / but no / system / under it.'), 5 at 320; every word fits a 358px line. The hidden kit menu is clipped below 1024 (as careers-, about- and contact-head do), so the head measures 390 at 390 and 320 at 320; at ≤359 the lockup steps to 20px and the outlined action tightens (as article- and insights-head), so they no longer touch.
notes: Coherence pass 2: the side lede is cut to two lines (“For companies that sell to committees, with someone inside to own what we build.”). Casting kept as briefed: 112px, side, accent a phrase mid-sentence — set mid-line too ('but no system'), so it never reads as GTM Intelligence's whole-line accent. No red in the head except the kit rule. Crop unchanged (the brief's verified crop) and re-checked with qa/r9-fix/cropcheck.mjs on the stitch and the fragment: window x 373–907 · y 319–531 of the 1920 × 964 picture, right edge 909 through the drift, left half at 1440/834/390. Tone: the blur stays at the founder's 8px floor (round-5 film update: 8–12px); the frost (--plate-frost .10, kit default .24), grain (--plate-grain .30, default .42) and brightness (--film-bright 1.04, base .92) are lifted so the jaw, the neck and the white shirt beyond read as people rather than a brown blur (qa/r9-pages/wwww/r9fix/tone-sheet.png: a = before, d = chosen). The crop is still mostly a shoulder against a lit shape — the real footage is the fix (shoot brief above). The crop is the founder's call (standing rules 5 and 6), labelled as a proposal. No v4 photograph anywhere on the page. Coherence pass 3: cast 104 (was 112: in the side column it broke to “Real / revenue, / but no / system / under it.” at 1024) with a 48px phone floor, so every line holds two or more words from 1440 to 320.
